indicators.indicator: Population without safely managed drinking water
indicators.notes: 2.2B people lack safely managed drinking water (JMP 2023). Of these, 703M have no basic water service. Concentrated in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Update from washdata.org annually.
3.5B people lack safely managed sanitation. Highest burden in South Asia (1.5B) and Sub-Saharan Africa (1.0B). Update from washdata.org annually.
419M people still practicing open defecation globally (JMP 2023). Down from 892M in 2000 but progress slowing. Primary contamination driver for groundwater.
